SIMPLIFICATION: flag clear unnecessary complexity - redundant/derivable state, copy-paste test cases differing only in data, dead code (verify truly unreachable across all Trigger types), deep nesting, redundant comments. The if-constexpr/requires duck-typing for observe_commit is load-bearing - do NOT flag it. Name the simpler behavior-preserving form.

HARD BAR: concrete, high-confidence, behavior-preserving findings whose fix stays within these files (or calls an existing helper). No architectural rewrites, no new abstractions, no API changes.

OUTPUT: numbered list, each line `path:line | angle | problem | concrete fix`. Skip clean files. If nothing actionable, output exactly `CLEAN`. No preamble/tables/summary.

Each round reads the best-so-far RISC-V assembly (LMUL, VLmax, register spills) to ground the next tile-size proposal; pre-compile divisibility gate ensures tiles divide their parent extents (no tail loop); a post-compile check of the IR after iree-codegen-generic-vectorization confirms no tail/masked main path.
